effect.name: Effect Layer Style Glass (NV)
effect.desc: NodeVideo effect 'NodeVideo/Effect/layer_style_glass': turns the layer into glass that refracts what is behind it, with diffuse light and a specular shine on the edge.
effect.desc-en: NodeVideo effect 'NodeVideo/Effect/layer_style_glass': turns the layer into glass that refracts what is behind it, with diffuse light and a specular shine on the edge.
